about: .XN--MGBX4CD0AB is a country-code top-level domain (ccTLD) in the DNS root zone. It is designated for Malaysia. The IANA root zone lists the registry manager as MYNIC Berhad. Registration policies (who may register, local presence, pricing) are set by the registry and its accredited registrars — not by IANA.
whoCanRegister: Eligibility is defined by the registry operator and its registrars. Most gTLDs are open to anyone worldwide. Many ccTLDs are also open globally; some require local presence, citizenship, or trademark rights. Always confirm current policy with the registry or your registrar.
